title: Hand it to the next shire: on-chip relay vs DRAM · ET-SoC-1
description: A multi-stage computation that passes each stage's output to another shire's scratchpad instead of writing it to DRAM runs 12 times faster and uses a twelfth of the energy per byte. Measured on two ET-SoC-1 cards, with the boundary where the advantage appears and the one where it runs out.
